notes.title: Future Content Update!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45058166/3a60862d44dbfc26326604013f85502bf345dc0e.png[/img]

[h3][b]Thank You for an Incredible Launch![/b][/h3]

[b]BUG NOTICE[/b] : If you encounter annoying bugs either solo or in the multiplayer don't hesitate to jump on the discord. My goal is to fix them as soon as possible. So having your logs files can really help me improve the experience! Thank you guys!

Hello everyone!

A quick update on the next big free update, it’s coming as soon as possible! I'm working as fast as I can, but I’ve been adding more than I originally planned, which is why it’s taking a bit longer.

Here’s what’s changing in a few words. Right now, when you defeat a MiniBoss, a Benediction Stone drops from the sky. That’s going away! Instead, to unlock Benedictions, you'll need to embark on expeditions, gather resources, and rebuild a temple to invoke the gods.

What’s coming in the update?
✔️ (80%) Expedition system with randomly generated maps
✔️ (50%) New, tougher MiniBosses found in expeditions
✔️ (100%) Complete combat system rework—better and more interesting creatures
✔️ (100%) 5 Professions: Mining, Chopping, Gathering, Digging, and Skinning (with multi-level resources)
✔️ (75%) A brand-new class: The Archer
✔️ (10%) A rework of spells to better fit the theme + new spells!
✔️ (0%) A new temple in fights to call upon the gods
✔️ (100%) A dedicated area for professions + improving favor with each god
✔️ (100%) A new way to upgrade and enhance your potions
✔️ (100%) A cooking system to prepare food using the meat gathered in expeditions

I can’t wait for you all to experience these changes! Stay tuned for more updates. 🚀

Here is a glimpse of what I'm working on! March is going to be a great month!
For more details, don't forget to join the discord [url=https://discord.gg/4g4EJjcDwU]join the discord[/url].

See you in the arena!

Benjamin

-----------------
亲爱的玩家们，

我刚刚发现我使用的 Unity 多人服务在中国无法运行，这就是游戏无法联网的原因。对此我深感抱歉！🙏 我会尽快研究解决方案，看看如何修复这个问题。

感谢大家的支持和耐心！❤️

— Benjamin

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45058166/3a60862d44dbfc26326604013f85502bf345dc0e.png[/img]

notes.title: Thank you & Future Content Update!
notes.content:

[h3][b]Thank You for an Incredible Launch![/b][/h3]

[b]BUG NOTICE[/b] : If you encounter annoying bugs either solo or in the multiplayer don't hesitate to jump on the discord. My goal is to fix them as soon as possible. So having your logs files can really help me improve the experience! Thank you guys!

Hello everyone!

I just wanted to take a moment and say a MASSIVE THANK YOU to all of you who have bought my game. The fact that so many of you were able to defeat Death has been incredible.
Being a solo dev, your support is everything for me, and it makes me want to create even more!

Speaking of more content! I’m actively working on the first big free content update! I'm working on a [b]new class[/b] and a [b]new game mode[/b]. My goal is to give you more variability and more control to enhance your character to be more powerful! I hope I'll push this update in [b][i]a month from now[/i][/b] !

Thanks again for being part of this journey. Whether you're battling solo or with friends, your enthusiasm and feedback keep me going every day.

See you in the arena!

Benjamin

notes.title: Release Patch 11!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45058166/3a60862d44dbfc26326604013f85502bf345dc0e.png[/img]

[h3][b]Release Patch 11 - The Blood Patch![/b][/h3]

[h5][b]Main[/b][/h5]
[list]
[*]You can now show all the non 16:9 / 16:10 resolutions in the Graphic menu
[*]The Portal with the colored ball Event now uses 3 colors in Normal Mode (RGB) and 4 colors in HM (RGBY). The time to switch to another color is 4 sec in NM and 3 sec in HM
[*]Added a new AoE pattern
[*]Killing a creature generate a blood explosion!
[*]In the Fight Summary, you can see what killed you
[/list]

[h5][b]Benedictions[/b][/h5]
[list]
[*]Balder Rock : Buff the spawn rate at early levels and nerf the spawn rate and late levels
[/list]


[h5][b]Skill[/b][/h5]
[list]
[*]Fear improve duration from Arrow Volley nerfed from 5 sec per upgrade to 1 sec
[*]Thor’s Power has a new icon, no more black and white confusion, it’s fully red now !
[/list]


[h5][b]Bug Fix[/b][/h5]
[list]
[*]It is now not possible to go in the arena and not start the fight by doing some jumping puzzles
[*]The bleeding from the Heat Weather effect now doesn’t stack like crazy
[*]Lower the volume of the Weather effects
[*]Lower the volume of the ambience music in the Where Is Waldo Skull Event
[*]Fix a shader crash
[*]Fix a few translations missing
[*]Fix a bug where the player rotated randomly in one direction
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45058166/3a60862d44dbfc26326604013f85502bf345dc0e.png[/img]

notes.title: Release Patch 10!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45058166/3a60862d44dbfc26326604013f85502bf345dc0e.png[/img]

[h3][b]Release Patch 10 ![/b][/h3]

[h5][b]Main[/b][/h5]
[list]
[*]Going to the next phase now also kills all destructable
[*]New filter in the Constellation Panel to be able to select star with a combination of passives (AND / OR slider)
[*]Now indicate in the Star tooltip the number of reroll / upgrade left (if you have unlock the improve tab)
[*]Destroying one skull now stun the boss for 1 sec instead of 2
[*]The boss now starts gaining his invulnerability shield before teleporting to the center for either the Skull Event or the Invasion. This change and the previous one make the boss more reactive to the players actions
[/list]

[h5][b]Leaderboards[/b][/h5]
[list]
[*]Leaderboard HM fixed! You can now appear in it!
[*]You can now see your Leaderboard rank live in the HardMode Selection panel
[*]Added a new leaderboard counting the max Soul Brand you collected (the Hard Mode green skulls)
[/list]

[h5][b]HardMode[/b][/h5]
[i]Theses changes enable more strategies to kill the boss instead of using the shout for it to proc other spells. And it makes HM shorter in time but more deadly[/i]
[list]
[*]Lowered the HP in every HardMode phase, so the fight feel more like a progress rather than spending max time on P1
[*]Increase creature health from 100% to 125%
[*]Increase damage taken from +75% to +150%
[*]Lower creature spawn from 50% to 25% (this is just affecting the beginning of the fight, you’ll reach crazy number at the end anyway, it just scales better)
[*]Increase the difficulty of the SpotLight Skull Event in HardMode (the one where you avoid the lights)
[*]Rebalancing of the Soul Brand (Green HM Skulls) so they add up to 100
[/list]

[h5][b]Skills[/b][/h5]
[list]
[*]Adding a one more charge to one of your spell add it directly now. No more waiting!
[*][Hammer Invocation] Lower the base stun passive duration from 1 sec to 0.5s
[*][Hammer Invocation] Lower the increase duration of the stun from 2 sec per bonus to 1 sec
[*][Shout] Increase the cooldown from 20 sec to 22 sec
[/list]

[h5][b]Other[/b][/h5]
[list]
[*]In the Fight Summary you can now see the number of Soul Brand you picked for the current run (The Hard Mode green skulls)
[*]New drop shadow on most UI text in game
[/list]

[h5][b]Bug Fix[/b][/h5]
[list]
[*]Fix a display bug with the boss nameplate not replenishing on a healthbar killing blow
[*]In multiplayer, if you “Surrender” via the option while you are already dead, you don’t die again!
[*]Reimported the localisation for Japanese, Korean, Chinese, now there should be no missing characters
[*]Fix the visual of the Attack Combo fire effect and HardMode health bar effect on 16:10 resolution screens
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45058166/3a60862d44dbfc26326604013f85502bf345dc0e.png[/img]

notes.title: Release Patch 9!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45058166/3a60862d44dbfc26326604013f85502bf345dc0e.png[/img]

[h3][b]Release Patch 9 ![/b][/h3]

[h5][b]Main[/b][/h5]
[list]
[*]When you proc your death save it is now clearly indicated above the player’s head
[*]The Timer now stops when the boss is dead (only for local history, the Leaderboard always received the exact timing)
[*]Rebalancing of the number of kills needed to upgrade a Benediction (when starting with one)
[*]Bleeding now deals damage in % (2% for Normal Mode, 5% for HardMode)
[*]Boss damage reduction is now capped at 90%
[*]In HardMode every mini bosses now gives a 7.5% damage reduction instead of 10%
[*]In HardMode, rebalance the toughness gained by the boss per phase
[list]
[*]P1 : 20 » 15
[*]P2 : 25 » 20
[*]P3 : 30 » 25
[/list]
[/list]
[h5][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h5]
[list]
[*]The tree in P3 that prevented the laser from going through in the Mirror Event was cut down!
[*]Leveling up because of the damage of Charged Slam now doesn’t reset its cooldown
[*]Killing the boss while leveling up now doesn’t freeze the word “Killed” locking the game
[*]Looting multiple Hel’s Circle at the same time now doesn’t create multiple Circles
[*]Telegraphs projections are now on top of the Wheel Of Fortune and Color Wheel Skull Events
[*]Fixed a bug where the level of Heimdall Pillar don’t reset when the fight ends
[*]Picking up a benediction when they are disabled (Skull Events) doesn’t make them re-appear
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45058166/3a60862d44dbfc26326604013f85502bf345dc0e.png[/img]

notes.title: Release Patch 8!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45058166/3a60862d44dbfc26326604013f85502bf345dc0e.png[/img]

[h3][b]Release Patch 8 ![/b][/h3]

[h5][b]Main[/b][/h5]
[list]
[*]Creatures now spawn around the boss and not the player
[*]A lot of Event related damage are now player’s health % based and unavoidable (no more cheating!)
[*]You now need to truly perfectly accomplish an event before receiving the achievement for it
[*]The boss now talks…
[*]You can now surrender during the fight via the menu
[*]Resetting the fight now despawn all the loot (you should have gathered it before… or buy the auto loot)
[*]When the mini bosses are auto killed by the boss launching a Skull Event, they no longer drop Benediction Stones
[*]For every mini boss alive, Death gains a buff protecting it from damage
[/list]

[h5][b]Skill[/b][/h5]
[list]
[*]To compensate for the unskippable damage of some mechanics, the CD of Invulnerability is lowered from 45 to 40
[*]Deploy Shield now prevents the player from obtaining Death Mark on every monster hit
[/list]

[h5][b]Skull Events[/b][/h5]
[list]
[*][Wheel Of Fortune] The safe rune is now displayed under the neon timer instead of one’s player head
[*][Wheel of Fortune] Failing now deal 350 instead of 250 in normal mode
[*][Skull Event - Electricity Pillar] The speed at which in converge or diverge is slightly slower
[/list]

[h5][b]Benediction[/b][/h5]
[list]
[*]The bonus allowing you to spawn more benedictions per mini boss is now capped at 1 more
[/list]

[h5][b]Other[/b][/h5]
[list]
[*]Various optimisation across all systems
[*]Added a Credit button to the menu to show…the credit!
[*]Added a neon arrow in town by the Benediction Rock until you open the Benediction UI
[*]When the boss kills all the creatures to spawn an event there is a visual wave crossing the screen and the destructables like towers are also destroyed
[*]During the fight when the skill choices appear there is a grace window before the skills are selectable to ensure no wrong clicks
[*]Closing the character selection window now auto select the last viewed character
[*]Invulnerability now protect against being pulled or bumped
[*]Now only display the number of stacks on a boss debuff/buff when there is more than 1
[*]Mini bosses health bar are now behind everything UI element
[*]Approching a Benediction Stone now highlight which one is selected
[*]Double the size of the invulnerability shield dropping on the ground
[*]New mini boss, the cave crasher got an update
[*]Visiting the Credit page awards 50 blood crystals
[*]There is now a report bug button in the option redirecting to the game’s Discord
[*]New option to hide the active benediction panels during the fight
[/list]

[h5][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h5]
[list]
[*][Skull Event - Electricity Pillar Converging] The converging AoE is now back!
[*]Visual bug - Hide the lock (and particles) on the Improving Stars handle in the Constellation panel the first time it is open after unlocking it
[*]Fixed the collider of the Pizza Telegraph which captured the player way off the area
[*]Dragging a bifrost into its slot in a weird way now doesn’t leave you with a sprite hanging
[*]Visual bug - Unlocking forging or improving stars now correctly remove the locked handle
[*]Visual bug - The reset sound button now have the correct text
[*]Fix a bug occurring when looting a Benediction Stone at the same time as the fight resets (death)
[*]Fix the collider on the bump player boss action
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45058166/3a60862d44dbfc26326604013f85502bf345dc0e.png[/img]

notes.title: Demo Patch 7!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45058166/3a60862d44dbfc26326604013f85502bf345dc0e.png[/img]

[h3][b]Demo Patch 7 ![/b][/h3]

[h5][b]Main[/b][/h5]
[list]
[*]On the Character Panel, you can now join a Viking Clan to gain a small buff
[*]New loading screen after the game logo
[*]Creatures are automatically killed when a Skull Event start
[*]Creatures now can’t spawn during a Skull Event
[*]Stars forging price increase by x3

[/list]

[h5][b]Skull Events[/b][/h5]
[list]
[*]Improve the skull event where multiple towers are aiming at you (the laser stops as soon as you kill the tower, you can traverse the tower as soon as you kill it)
[*]Lower the damage of the rotating electrical pillars
[*]The boss now takes 50% less damage from benedictions
[/list]

[h5][b]Others[/b][/h5]
[list]
[*]Added sounds to some telegraphs
[*]Pausing in fight now…pauses the game! (except in multiplayer)
[*]Lower the time the green puddles dropped by the player stay on the ground from 120 sec to 25 sec
[*]Added an in game bubble showing the current selected constellation
[*]In the fight summary you can now see the final benediction level (only for new fight summaries)
[*]Add a particle effect to attract to player’s eyes to the panel to unlock improving and forging stars
[*]Lower the price of rerolling and improving stars
[*]New general tooltip in the constellation UI to help newcomers
[*]The pull attack from Death is now yellow as it doesn’t do damage
[*]Increase the cooldown of the skill Invulnerability from 25 to 45 sec
[*]Improve the randomness of the different Room AoE that the boss can spawn to give equal chances to telegraphs without variations (ie : the meteor will now have the same spawn probability than the fire one which had left / right / top variations)
[/list]

[h5][b]Benedictions[/b][/h5]
[list]
[*]Lower Loki Chakram damage
[*]Lower Hel’s Circle damage
[*]Increase Thor’s Lightning damage
[*]The buyable speed passive increase per benediction is now capped at 100%
[/list]

[h5][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h5]
[list]
[*]Fix a rare bug preventing the fight summary to be displayed
[*]The slashing hit sound from the scythes was surprisingly too loud
[*]Fix a bug in the Constellation panel you had to unlock “improving stars” to be able to forge new stars
[*]Fix a visual bug that when you killed a mini boss, its health bar didn’t move to 0
[*]Dying during a creature invasion now removes the green progress bar
[*]The benediction speed passive is now applied while jumping
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45058166/3a60862d44dbfc26326604013f85502bf345dc0e.png[/img]

notes.title: Demo Patch 6!
notes.content:

[h3][b]Demo Patch 6 ![/b][/h3]

notes.title: Tripling Wishlists During Steam Fest
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45058166/3a60862d44dbfc26326604013f85502bf345dc0e.png[/img]

[h3][b]1,500 Wishlists Reached![/b][/h3]

Hey everyone,
I’m thrilled to share some incredible news!
During the recent Steam Fest, One Boss One Fight saw a massive boost in popularity, tripling the wishlists from 500 to over 1500 in just one week! 🎉

The response has been amazing, with around 90% of players who tried the demo choosing to wishlist the game. I love to see the excitement around my crazy one Boss battle game!

This project is the culmination of 8 months of hard work by just me, so seeing such enthusiasm is mind blowing. If you haven’t had the chance to check out the demo yet, now’s the perfect time to dive in and experience the thrill for yourself.

Everything is on track for the full release in late November, and I can’t wait to share it with you all. You have no idea what I have prepared (insert an evil laugh!)

Thank you so much for your support, and be sure to join our Discord for the latest updates!
See you in OBOF,
Benjamin


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45058166/3a60862d44dbfc26326604013f85502bf345dc0e.png[/img]
